preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through social engineering/compromise)
Contract must be initialized and trading enabled

violation_target.exploit_hint: As owner, call setWallets() to change marketing/development wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, then trigger contractSwap() via a sell transaction to divert ETH fees to attacker wallets. Alternatively, use sweepContingency() before liquidity is added, or manipulate taxes/ratios to extract maximum value from traders.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract allows the owner to change tax recipient wallets via setWallets(). By setting both marketing and development wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, any ETH collected from taxes will be sent to the attacker. Combined with high sell taxes (development: 1400 out of 2100 totalSwap), selling tokens will accumulate significant ETH in the contract which then gets distributed to the attacker's wallets.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the owner, change tax wallets to attacker address, buy tokens, then sell tokens to trigger tax collection and ETH distribution to attacker.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Impersonate owner using vm.prank
2. Call setWallets() to set both marketing and development to attacker address
3. Buy tokens through the DEX pair to accumulate tax tokens in contract
4. Sell tokens to trigger contractSwap() which converts tax tokens to ETH and distributes to attacker wallets
5. Verify ETH balance increased
